# Responses protocol fixtures

These files are synthetic, minimal examples of the public Responses protocol.
They are not captures from a client or service.

Do not add authorization headers, bearer tokens, API keys, environment values,
private paths, client metadata, or runtime traces.

The examples cover a streamed request, client-side tool search with an empty
result, and a deferred tool follow-up. Behavioral coverage belongs in unit
tests; fixture data must remain portable and privacy-safe.
